entries.name: Peasant
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production game rank badge. Input image is the approved rank reference board, used as the exact visual reference. Produce ONLY the single requested rank emblem, faithfully matching its motif, silhouette, proportions, material palette and warm painterly embossed 3D-metal craftsmanship from that board. Exact emblem specification: A round wooden buckler with warm wood grain and bronze rim, a tied bundle of golden wheat centered on the wood, modest olive laurel branches and a short green cloth ribbon below. No military helmet, star or crown.
